verdict.rationale: Metorial explicitly provides hosted MCP endpoints — Magic MCP servers give 'a hosted MCP endpoint for a provider' managed entirely by Metorial, portals let users 'copy a standard MCP URL for their AI client,' and sessions return a `connection_url` an MCP client can connect to directly, all without the developer deploying infrastructure. This is corroborated by community reaction praising 'MCP containers available separately' and live probes confirming the docs/API are real and functioning. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of actually connecting a client end-to-end to a hosted URL (only vendor docs and a probe of docs/API, not the connect flow itself).
